independence_note: Own scope conclusion logged before consulting any sibling or archived mathematical review. Source-authored status mentions were not treated as verification evidence.
followup_rationale: No follow-up meets the requested high bar. Optimal KS distortion is already an established question in Lytchak–Wenger, and broad questions about other energies would require a new classification mechanism or a precisely supported conjecture. This review supplies neither, so no speculative prompt is added.
key_boundaries: Reshetnyak local fixed-trace minimizer, not KS harmonic or a global homotopy minimizer.
Smooth homeomorphism need not have smooth inverse; essential unboundedness on positive-area sets.
Separate nonsharp KS constant; older sharper 2sqrt(2)+sqrt(6) is credited.
Comparison bound to inspected MVW arXiv v1 and workshop question, no first-priority/current-openness claim.
